rationale: C06 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It addresses the identical Interstate Highway financing problem and assembles the same distinctive elements: the Administration's commitment to an urgent, uninterrupted program; the pay-as-you-go principle embodied in the Highway Act of 1956; the requested 1½-cent gas-tax increase; insufficient congressional revenue action; and the resulting threat to keeping the program on schedule. The child updates this argument after Congress enacted only a delayed one-cent increase and explains the administrative response of scheduling new contracts. C24 and C19 have weaker parallels involving highway-budget constraints and pay-as-you-go taxation, respectively, but neither reproduces this distinctive combination.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Last January I recommended that the Congress increase the gas tax by 1 ½ cents to be effective July 1, 1959.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It was, of course, for this purpose that I proposed a 1 1/2 cent increase in the gas tax in my budget message submitted to the Congress on January 19, 1959.
shared_material.explanation: The same unusually specific tax proposal and legislative history anchor both letters.

shared_material.child_excerpt: while still adhering to the legislative directive establishing the "pay-as-you-go" principle in the Highway Act of 1956
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Only in this way can we continue the pay-as-you-go principle which was embodied in the Highway Act of 1956
shared_material.explanation: This is close literal language tying the financing position to the same statute and principle.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the orderly scheduling of new contracts is the only prudent and equitable course to follow
shared_material.parent_excerpt: continuing the program on schedule and without interruption... keep the interstate program on schedule
shared_material.explanation: Both organize the administrative argument around maintaining or adjusting the program's schedule in response to inadequate Trust Fund revenues.

shared_material.child_excerpt: If... Congress takes further action... to provide... additional revenues for the Trust Fund, the scheduling now contemplated will be adjusted
shared_material.parent_excerpt: join me in urging the Congress to support an appropriate proposal to bring new revenues into the Highway Trust Fund
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts C06's request for additional congressional Trust Fund revenue to the later post-legislation situation.
